description: Two shared propositional formulas \(A,B\) agree under every valuation exactly when \(\{A\}\vdash B\) and \(\{B\}\vdash A\) in the existing natural-deduction calculus.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BooleanAlgebrasOfFormulas.equivalent_iff_proofs.{u} {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α]
  (A B : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.PropFormula α) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.SemEquivalent A B ↔
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.Derives {A} B ∧ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.Derives {B} A
